turns.assessment: The failure is receiver-local: trx.och140.z developed a severe BER increase followed by OTU frame loss, with prior errored seconds already present. Received power, estimated OSNR, DGD, SOP rate, channel monitors, and all amplifiers remained normal; the parallel och139 channel was also unaffected. This strongly excludes fibre, amplifier, connector, and transmitter-loss faults and favors degradation of the S23 receiver, although a channel-specific WSS filter penalty remains a smaller alternative.

proposals.rationale: Errors and OTU_LOF occur only at this receiver while optical power, OSNR, polarization metrics, the line system, and another S01-S23 channel remain normal. The earlier errored-seconds indication also supports receiver degradation preceding the loss of framing.

A channel-specific shifted or narrowed WSS passband can cause high BER and frame loss without changing measured channel power or estimated OSNR, but there is no evidence localizing such a shift to a particular ROADM.
